description: P6 field-mapping C[double-outline] / J[map-border]: the double-line map-frame border structure (M44/M45/M46). Inner and outer stroke widths and the gap between them are physical mm (never multiplied by reference-px scale). The gap is the appearance spacing between the two border lines, not a Layout container margin; outer offset is mechanically computed from gap plus half-widths. Border color lives in the Style map_border role (A). What the border surrounds (placed-map-content vs view-frame) is a binding decision (X06), baseline placed-map-content. Closed.
